_about: Villagers' requests: small asks of their own (a pouch, a scarf, new tools) and asks for the whole village (pouches for every worker). One wanting something shows a gold ! over their head; talking to them, Sera gives her word, and it goes in the journal (J). Handing the thing over (from her bag, or storage while she's in the village) settles it, for thanks and gold. 'wants' is what makes someone ask (bag: a worker with nothing to carry more in; scarf: autumn or winter, none round their neck; tools: a miner or woodcutter whose tools are worn through). 'kind' is the kind of item that answers it (ui.json's items). 'soon': asked straight away, not waiting its turn (one of the party with no mist crystal). 'item': the one item that answers it, where 'kind' alone would take any of that kind. 'every' asks are for the whole village: open once enough are wanting ('least'), done when nobody's wanting any more; Sachets or scarves put in storage are handed out to those wanting. 'days': how long one waits before giving up on Sera. An ask with no 'kind' or 'item' is for something to build, not hand over (the cellar: wanted while the chests hold plenty of food and there's no cellar; done once one's built). See scripts/requests.gd.

requests.title: A pouch for {name}
ask: I keep going back and forth to storage with half a load. A pouch would let me carry more.
If I had a little bag, a Sachet, I could bring home twice as much.
thanks: A pouch of my own! I'll fill it every trip.
Oh, this is perfect. Thank you, {miko}!
requests.note: Make a Sachet at the tool workbench (Hide and Wood) and give it to them.

requests.title: A scarf for {name}
ask: The cold's coming. I've nothing to wrap round my neck.
My fingers and my neck ache in the cold. A scarf would help.
thanks: Winter won't bite so hard now. Thank you, {miko}.
requests.note: Make a Scarf at the tool workbench (Fiber) and give it to them.

requests.title: New tools for {name}
ask: My tools are worn through. I'm working with my bare hands.
I can't chop or dig like this. Could you get me new tools?
thanks: Good tools! Now we'll get somewhere.
Back to work, properly this time. Thank you!
requests.note: Make Tools at the tool workbench (Wood and Stone) and give them to them, or leave them in storage.

requests.title: A mist crystal for {name}
ask: {miko}, out there in the mist... you've your crystal, and I've nothing. Could you make me one too?
The mist gets into my head when we go out. A crystal necklace, like yours, would keep it off me.
requests.accept: I'll make you a crystal necklace.
thanks: It's glowing! I feel steadier already. Thank you, {miko}.
Now the mist can't touch me either. Thank you!
requests.note: Make a Crystal Necklace at the tool workbench (mist crystals and fiber) and give it to her: she'll wear it as her trinket.

requests.title: Pouches for every worker
ask: Half of us carry whatever fits in our arms. If every worker had a pouch, we'd bring home so much more.
thanks: Every one of us has a pouch now. Look at all we're bringing home!
requests.note: Make Sachets at the tool workbench and give them out, or put them in storage: those without take one.

requests.title: Scarves before winter
ask: Winter's on its way and most of us have nothing warm. A scarf for everyone would see us through.
requests.accept: Scarves for everyone before the snow.
thanks: Everyone's wrapped up warm. Let the snow come!
requests.note: Make Scarves at the tool workbench and give them out, or put them in storage: those without take one.

requests.title: A cellar for the food
ask: {miko}, the chests are full of food and it's going off before we can eat it. A cellar would keep it cold.
There's more food than we can eat before it spoils. If we dug a cellar, it'd keep for days.
thanks: A cellar! The food will keep so much longer down there. Thank you, {miko}.
requests.note: Build a Cellar (Storage, in the build menu) in the village: its doors go in the ground outdoors. The villagers carry the food down themselves.
